overall: The AG found that a councilor's March 30 email, sent to seven of the thirteen council members and expressing his opinion on IT privatization, was a deliberation outside a meeting. The violation was individual, not the council's, and the councilor was ordered to comply in the future.

allegations.summary: A councilor emailed seven council members, a quorum of the 13-member council, giving his opinion on a pending matter (privatizing city IT staff).
allegations.key_passage: Expression of an opinion on matters within a body's jurisdiction to a quorum of a public body is a deliberation, even if no other public body member responds.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law ordered for the individual councilor.
remedy_passage: We order Councilor DiNatale's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
